551503.name: High-Power Beam
551503.description: Fires a high-power beam at a single Nikke, dealing massive damage.

551504.name: Unknown Shock Wave
551504.description: Generates a code barrier and emits a shock wave, dealing damage to all Nikkes. While the barrier is up, only Wind Code Nikkes can deal damage.

551505.name: Unknown Splitting Missiles
551505.description: Fires a barrage of unknown objects, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

551507.name: Unknown Light Beam
551507.description: Emits an unknown light beam. This attack must be interrupted via Special Interruption; otherwise, it deals massive damage to all Nikkes.

551509.name: Unknown Projectiles
551509.description:
Fires unknown projectiles, dealing damage to multiple Nikkes.
The unknown projectiles can be intercepted.

551518.name: Unknown Flash
551518.description:
Unleashes Unknown Flash, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
If Unknown Force Field remains, it deals massive additional damage.

551520.name: Unknown Force Field
551520.description:
Reduces the damage taken by Massive Object Q.
Unknown Force Field can be stacked up to 4 times and is consumed each time Massive Object Q attacks.
If a Nikke takes damage from Massive Object Q, 1 stack of Unknown Force Field will be generated.
